lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Emma Simpson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Emma Simpson is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Emma kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Emma's gone." Eli looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Emma." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. LaToya blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Emma Simpson, 41 days. The mantle passes to LaToya Khanna.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. LaToya Khanna, 61 — a zookeeper. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Emma — and Emma is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Eli, Duc, Didier and 4 more speak for LaToya — "Emma trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew LaToya before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
